rows.grounds: negated compound/object indicating absence of extraction; mantra-extraction context
optative injunction regarding writing or inscribing
indeclinable indicating manifest or immediate presence
compound denoting the sovereign mistress of letters
qualifies the sovereign of letters as the highest

items.question: In what manner must the supreme sovereign of letters not be inscribed?
premises: The injunction prohibits writing an extraction.
The supreme sovereign of letters is directly manifest.
items.inference: Therefore, the supreme sovereign of letters should not be inscribed in an extracted form but recognized as directly present.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of uddhāra in this ritual context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: O goddess, one should not write the supreme sovereign of letters in extracted form, for she is directly manifest.
